total_model.summary: Model projects 49.5 total points (LA 28, GB 22). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.8), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.7), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
